book.name: Matei
book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Matei

content: Yesu jutenda kulengwa
Ndipala Loho jaka Sapanga jundongua Yesu mbaka kulukoba ili julengwa ni Lijobi.
Japungiki kula posu masoba komi nsesi muhi ni ikilu, pajajomula jumbina inzala.
Ndienu Lijobi, lunhikila nukunkolo, “Ana wehapa wa Mwana waka Sapanga, ugapwagila malibu aga gabiya mabumunda.”
Yesu jajibua, “Aandiki mu Maandiku gaka Sapanga, ‘Mundu ngasejuwesa kutama kupete mabumunda pena, ila kwa kila lilobi lejupwaga Sapanga.’ ”
Ndipala Lijobi lunzukua Yesu mbaka ku Yelusalemu, kumusi wa asapi, ambeka panani jikipagaa sa Nyumba jaka Sapanga.
Ndienu ampwagila, “Ana wehapa wa Mwana waka Sapanga, lilekala pai, ndaba aandiki mu Maandiku gaka Sapanga,

content.text: ‘Sapanga jaatuma atumi baki bu kunani bagukenga,

content: Yesu ampwagila, “Aandiki kabee mu Maandiku gaka Sapanga, ‘Wandenga Bambu, Sapanga wako.’ ”
Ndipala, Lijobi anzukua kabee mbaka panani ji kitombi kilasu, andangia ubambu ukolongu wa ndema yoka na nu ukolongu waki woti.
Ndienu lumpwagila, “Yenze yoti misinugupekia ana gunyinamii nu kungungamali.”
Yesu ampwagila, “Boka neapa Lijobi wee! Aandiki mu Maandiku gaka Sapanga, ‘Gungungamaliya Bambu Sapanga waku, nukuntumakii jombi kajika jaki.’ ”
Ndienu Lijobi lundeka Yesu, na atumi bu kunani kwaka Sapanga bahika kuntumakii.
Yesu jutumbuli kaalandi bandu
Yesu pajajoa Yohana ampeliki mu kipungu, jajenda ku Galilaya.
Jaboka ku Nazaleti, jajenda ku Kapelinaumu, musi gogubii pambipi nu nhanga uku Genesaleti, gogupakini nu nndema uku Zebuluni nuku Nafutali, jatama kokuje.
Ndi latimia lilobi lejapwaaga Mlota waka Sapanga Isaya,

content.text: “Nndema guku Zebuluni nu nndema guku Nafutali,
indela jukuyetuki ku nhanga mulutengu ja losi luku Yoludani.
Galilaya, nndema wa bandu banga Ayaudi!
Bandu baatama pa lwii agubweni unang'anu nkolongu.
Nabombi baatama mundema ja lwii ni kihilu sa kuwa,

content: Tumbuka masoba gala Yesu jatumbuliya kulandi jakapwaga, “Nkotuka kuhenga mahakau, ndaba Ubambu ukolongu ukunani kwaka Sapanga guhegali!”
Yesu jaakema aloi nsesi bumpwata
Yesu pajabia jujenda mulutengu ju nhanga uku Galilaya, jaabona aka kilongu abeli aloi, Simoni jobunkema Petili nu nndongumundu Andilea. Babia bakalopula homba kwi ilepa mu nhanga ndaba babia aloi.
Yesu jaapwagila, “Mbwata nepani, na nepani nantenda mwanganya mbia mwa bandu babaleta bandu kwaka Sapanga.”
Apalapa biileka ilepa yabu, nukunzengale.

Ejwabia jujenda palongi kidogu, jaabona aka kilongu abeli, Yakobu na Yohana bana baka Zebedayu. Haba babia nkati junhwatu pamu na ahengo babu Zebedayu, bakalenganakiya ilepa yabu. Ndi Yesu jatenda kwaakema,
nabombi apalapa buguleka nhwatu pamu na ahengo babu, nukunzengale.
Yesu jaalamisa agonzu
Yesu jayongolatiya Galilaya joa, jatumbuliya kuboola mu nyumba yukuketangane Ayaudi, jaalandila bandu Lijambu la Amboni lu Ubambu ukolongu waka Sapanga. Jaalamisa bandu magonzu goa.

Majambu gaki gaeni pandu poti ku Silia. Ndienu bandu bumpelakiya agonzu boti, na bandu balwala ugonzu wokapi na baang'alika, baabii ni ilombu, bana kihinduhindu na bandu baalei, najombi jaalamisa boti.
Nsambi nkolongu wa bandu gwatenda kumpwata kuhuma ku Galilaya, nndema yuku Dekapoli maana jaki Misi Komi, Yelusalemu na Yudea na kwii ja losi luku Yoludani.
